senses.sense_definition: To design or produce computer code suitable for a specific processor or platform.

examples.text: This cross-platform compiler can <w>target</w> any of several processors.

target_lang_translations.tr: Bu çapraz platform derleyici, çeşitli işlemcilerden herhangi birini <w>hedefleyebilir</w>.
target_lang_translations.es: Este compilador multiplataforma puede <w>orientar</w> el código a varios procesadores.
